Sam K: Heads upKeeper question 1: trade completed last night, can that player be a keeper?
Priya M: Rules thread says 'owned by week 1' but we changed stuff last minute one year. ill look through pins.
Marco: My recollection: trades after week 14 were meant to be ineligible, but I could be misremembering.
Jen L: We didn't have a strict rule when we started the keeper thing. usually we avoid retroactive vetoes.
Alex: If we change rules now it's messy. Maybe offer a compromise instead of undoing the trade.
Dana: @Elliot you wrote the voting rules last season, right?
Elliot: Yep. I can run a quick poll. Proposal: Keep the trade intact, but award the acquiring owner a compensatory 3rd-round pick next year instead of keeper rights.
Sam K: Trade was recorded at 1991122320 (week 15). Under that proposal they'd lose keeper claim.
Priya M: Can't retroactively penalize someone, but comp pick seems fair.
Marco: +1 comp pick. avoids drama and keeps the roster alone.
Jen L: Agreed. Nobody wants a veto war.
Alex: Vote +1 for comp pick. Maybe add a rule for next season: owners must hold player 4 weeks before keeper eligibility.
Dana: Love that. Permanent rule would prevent these midseason debates.
leaguebot: Poll created: "Accept compensatory pick (round 3) instead of keeper for players acquired after week 14?" Voting open 48h. Recorded votes: Marco, Jen L, Alex, Dana, Elliot = yes.
Sam K: Thanks all. I'll DM the owner affected and offer the comp pick so we can close this quickly.
Priya M: Also, reminder: keeper declarations are due June 2nd last year, i'll confirm and pin it.
Elliot: I'll draft a one-line permanent rule and put it in the rules doc tonight.
Sam K: Sweet. No more surprise keeper drama :sweat_smile:
